evidence: Ter. Heaut. 2.3.123: in tempore ad eam vēnī (Lewis & Short)
Cic. Off. 1.27: ad tempus, for the moment (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: in tempore, at the right moment, just in time; ad tempus, on time, or for the moment; the very moment takes ipse (see just, exactly). “At the moment”, now, is nunc or in praesentiā (see now).

evidence: Sen. Ep. 104.6: ut prīmum gravitātem urbis excessī
Traupman 88: as soon as, cum prīmum

phrases.english: Father, you’ve come at just the right moment.

phrases.latin: quīn simul ac prōmīseris minerval, incipiam
phrases.english: why, I’ll begin the moment you’ve promised my fee

sources: Lewis & Short: tempus · Lewis & Short: opportune · Lewis & Short: primus · Lewis & Short: simul
